plan_area_inventory.title: Terse Caveman-style agent responses, intensity levels, coexistence with TOKEN_PROFILE and mandatory workflow gates
Scratchpad + template/example flags (default off) and operator documentation
Optional input-side file compression/minification with originals preserved and explicit scope policy
Commands, rules, hooks, scripts, tests, and template/ parity for both stories

topic_coverage.quoted_user_text: Goal: cost, speed, and readability together — Caveman-like terse assistant output in this kit, inspired by JuliusBrussee/caveman, without weakening its-magic workflow gates.
Cursor-only: ship behavior via .cursor/commands, .cursor/rules, hooks, skills, and repo docs for operators using Cursor here.
Surfaces: command specs, rules, hooks, Python under scripts/, engineering docs — no new mandatory npm deps unless architecture documents an exception.
Split stories: US-0089 = core Caveman mode + scratchpad flags; US-0090 = optional bounded input/file compression with explicit loss-avoidance after US-0089.
Scratchpad-first knobs (defaults off), e.g. CAVEMAN_MODE=0|1, CAVEMAN_LEVEL=lite|full|ultra, optional CAVEMAN_COMPRESS_INPUT and CAVEMAN_FILE_SCOPE — documented in scratchpad + template.
Safety baseline: never target secrets paths (.env, keys), canonical intake/evidence bundles, or binaries for silent rewrite; prose-only or explicit opt-in per architecture deny/allow lists.
Order: no content loss for protected artifacts, token reduction where provably safe, determinism, low maintenance, backward compatibility with TOKEN_PROFILE lineage, human readability.
Phase 1 done: Caveman mode configurable in scratchpad default off; CAVEMAN off preserves current behavior; tests added and passing; then /discovery for US-0089 with US-0090 as follow-on.
